### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Software Engineer building reusable generative AI services for Elsevier’s research, healthcare, and life sciences content platform. Leading architecture, backend development, Kubernetes deployment, and engineering standards.
Senior Software Engineer building Elsevier’s scalable generative AI platform services

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Software Engineer building reusable generative AI services for Elsevier’s research, healthcare, and life sciences content platform. Leading architecture, backend development, Kubernetes deployment, and engineering standards.
Senior Software Engineer building Elsevier’s scalable generative AI platform services
Role description:
• Lead architectural design and ensure technical consistency
• Design, develop, and maintain generative AI services and reusable components using mostly Python and some Java
• Define and promote engineering best practices, including scalability, observability, testing, and CI/CD
• Contribute to system designs spanning multiple services and modules
• Collaborate with product, platform, and research teams to translate AI prototypes into production-ready capabilities
• Deploy scalable, containerized applications in a Kubernetes (EKS) environment
• Lead resolution of complex technical challenges across distributed systems
• Mentor less-senior developers on engineering principles, GenAI patterns, and platform development
• Participate in code reviews, architecture sessions, and cross-team initiatives
• Stay informed about generative AI developments and advocate for responsible integration into product ecosystems
Role requirements:
• 4–6 years of software engineering experience
• Proven experience contributing to technical architecture for large-scale platforms or services
• Solid understanding of software development methodologies and data modeling principles
• Deep expertise in Python and Java
• Proficiency in backend development
• Familiarity with modern AI/LLM tools and frameworks, such as LangChain and LangGraph
• Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and cloud-native architectures
• Proven track record building scalable backend systems and APIs
• Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to architectural decisions
• Ability to work collaboratively across functions in an Agile or Kanban environment
• Experience operationalizing LLMs or building internal AI platforms is nice to have
• Familiarity with observability practices is nice to have
• Exposure to knowledge graphs or semantic search systems is nice to have
Benefits:
• Annual incentive bonus
• Country-specific benefits
• Accommodation or adjustment support for applicants with disabilities or other needs
Tech stack:
Cloud, Distributed Systems, Java, Kubernetes, Python
